//: Realtime Database security rules for the gomoku remote-play DB (remoteplay-b5486).
//paste: Firebase console -> Realtime Database -> Rules -> paste this -> Publish.
//why: Default test-mode rules ('.read'/'.write': true everywhere) let anyone read every game and write unlimited data, which is how a stranger can run up your quota. These rules confine all access to the /games/<code> paths the client actually uses, cap the room code and payload shapes, and deny everything else. There is no auth in the game, so writes stay open within those paths — pair this with Firebase budget alerts and a low daily usage cap.
